slots.palette: warm woodland palette with deep blue night accents
slots.setting: a cozy forest campsite at night for cute animals
slots.decorations: Only a few small pale birch logs, ferns and pine branches tucked into the corners of the screen.
slots.background_tones: warm where the firelight falls (pale birch, cream canvas) and deep blue-green in the shadows
slots.kitchen: a small wooden camp kitchen with a kettle
slots.loop_interior: a small stone campfire ring with soft, small, contained flames
slots.foods: a toasted marshmallow, a s'more, a grilled corn cob, a hot dog or a cup of cocoa
slots.board_surface: a pale cream canvas groundsheet framed with a thin birch-log border, lit by warm firelight
slots.obstacles: a pinecone, a small camp lantern and a tent peg
slots.mood: cozy, warm and peaceful, with everyone happily eating around the fire
slots.lighting: Warm soft firelight and lantern glow
slots.night_sky: a dark night all around the scene: the ground between the play areas is a deep blue-green forest floor in shadow, seen from directly above, with no sky and no stars
slots.light_sources: the small campfire inside the loop, camp lanterns hanging along the edges and above the counter
slots.effects: a few fireflies near the corners and faint sparks just above the campfire
slots.extra_avoid: large flames, smoke covering anything, fire outside the loop, a dark forest behind the board

kit.backdrop_ground: dark blue-green forest floor with a few soft warm firelight pools
kit.backdrop_edges: a few small pale birch logs, ferns and pine branches tucked into the four corners only, a couple of fireflies; no sky, no stars and no wide border
kit.mat_texture: a soft, even, barely visible canvas weave
kit.frame_piece: pale birch log with small dark bark marks
kit.frame_corner: a rope-lashed corner joint where two short pale birch logs cross at a right angle
kit.props_decor: a small camp kettle, a pine branch and a fern
